dedupe_keys.name: grid3 zmb socioeconomic vulnerability risk index in 1km squared grid

description: GRID3 ZMB - Socioeconomic Vulnerability Risk Index in 1km Squared Grid is a data set listed in Africa GeoPortal (Esri), a continental ArcGIS Hub, published or maintained by Geo-Referenced Infrastructure and Demographic Data for Development (GRID3). This layer is an index of socio-economic vulnerability to COVID-19 in the 1km squared grid, highlighting poor populations with limited options to cope with economic shocks. This layer classifies the raw PCA scores into quintles, with 1 defined as lowest risk and 5 defined as highest risk. Coverage: Zambia. The portal files it under the publisher Geo-Referenced Infrastructure and Demographic Data for Development (GRID3). Its tags are Fraym, GRID3, Zambia, ZMB, raster. The portal shows 2024-01-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record platform-africa-geoportal-esri.
